verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automation or agent workflow that runs autonomously in Raygun's background. The closest items are adjacent: alert rules that open PagerDuty incidents, conditional ignore rules for error triage, automatic source-map fetching, and an on-demand AI chat for error resolution. These are monitoring, alerting and triage features, not user-defined background automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
